description: This file contains unit tests for the PermissionSubjectsMap class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.enforcers.trie package. It tests various behaviors such as equality, adding entries, relation weights, union/intersection of subjects, copying, and modifications.

classes.name: PermissionSubjectsMapTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PermissionSubjectsMap, verifying its functionality.

methods.name: initConstants
methods.description: Initializes static constants used across tests, such as subject IDs and permissions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PermissionSubjectsMap before each test.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the hashCode and equals method implementations of PermissionSubjectsMap.

methods.name: tryToAddAllEntriesFromNull
methods.description: Checks that addAllEntriesFrom(null) throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addAllEntriesFromEmptyMapReturnsSame
methods.description: Verifies that adding an empty map returns the same instance.

methods.name: putReturnsNullForNewAssociation
methods.description: Ensures that putting a new permission returns null, indicating no previous association.

methods.name: putReturnsOldValueForNewAssociation
methods.description: Verifies that updating an existing permission returns the previous value.

methods.name: addTotalRelationOfWeightZeroWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests relation addition with zero weight for a set of permissions and subjects.

methods.name: weighSubjectIds
methods.description: Helper method to create a map of subject IDs to a specified weight for testing.

methods.name: getMaxWeightForAllPermissionsReturnsEmptyOptionalForEmptySubjectsMap
methods.description: Checks that no max weight is returned when the map is empty.

methods.name: getMaxWeightForAllPermissionsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures the maximum weight across subjects and permissions is correctly computed.

methods.name: getMaxNonemptyWeightForAllPermissionsReturnsEmptyOptionalIfNotAllPermissionsAreRelated
methods.description: Verifies that if not all permissions have related subjects, the result is empty.

methods.name: getMaxNonemptyWeightForAllPermissionsReturnsExpectedIfAllPermissionsAreRelated
methods.description: Checks correct max weight when all permissions are related to subjects.

methods.name: getSubjectUnionReturnsEmptyMapForEmptyPermissions
methods.description: Verifies that an empty permission set results in an empty union.

methods.name: getSubjectUnionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests the correctness of union of subjects for given permissions.

methods.name: getSubjectIntersectReturnsEmptyMapIfSubjectIdsAreNotRelatedToAllPermissions
methods.description: Verifies that the intersection is empty if subjects are not related to all permissions.

methods.name: getSubjectIntersectReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the intersection includes only subjects related to all permission sets.

methods.name: copyOfEmptyRelationReturnsDifferentEmptyRelation
methods.description: Ensures copying an empty relation produces a different but equal empty map.

methods.name: copyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that copying a populated map results in an equivalent map.

methods.name: copyWithIncrementedWeightReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests copying with weight increment.

methods.name: copyWithDecrementedWeightReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests copying with weight decrement.

methods.name: removeAllEntriesFromUpdateReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests removal of entries based on another map.

methods.name: addAllEntriesReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks adding all entries from another map results in correct combined data.
